gen-dafont-horizon-fs-karma: Horizon glows like bent neon glass, its rounded forms nearly sealed shut and its lowercase stretching generously upward. Karma answers by staying open, with serifs that finish clear of the stem.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-aldrich: Impact Label spaces each letter apart like beads on a rod. It hits hard with its pincer-like c, while Aldrich traces one thick, steady thread with cupped round letters.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-amiko: Commanding and heavy, Impact Label keeps every letter standing alone, with a high-set x-height guide above the rest. And Amiko, a plain sans with crayon-thick strokes and outward-pointing terminals, carries a longer passage with an easy, modern flow.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-anek-devanaga: Impact Label sets each letter apart like a bead on a rod, with c ends that flare open like pincers. And Anek Devanagari does the quieter work, offering distinctly open letter mouths and a generous middle zone for steady reading.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-anek-kannada: Anek Kannada reads contemporary and modern, its x-height reaching up like a squared-off woodblock letter with terminals stopping far from the stem. Impact Label brings the heavy, commanding punch, and that gap between loud and open is what makes the pair work.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-anek-latin: Anek Latin keeps its lowercase nearly as high as its capitals, with letters held open rather than curled shut. But under Impact Label's heavy, bead-on-a-rod letters, a longer passage feels neutral and unhurried.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-anek-malayala: Impact Label stands its letters apart like beads on a rod, heavy and commanding, with c ends splayed like pincers. And Anek Malayalam follows with a clean, contemporary plain sans, its curve tips left open, so paragraphs move along smoothly.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-anek-telugu: Each Impact Label letter stands alone like a bead on a rod, heavy and commanding, with pincer-open c ends. Anek Telugu carries a longer stretch with wide, lofty bowls and unlatched rounds, clean and approachable throughout.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-arimo: Commanding, heavy Impact Label sets letters apart like beads on a rod. Arimo then carries a longer passage with a high mean line and spacious gaps in its rounded glyphs, neutral and easy to settle into.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-armata: Beads on a rod, then open breathing room. Impact Label hits hardest with its pincer-like c and high-set x-height guide, while Armata, a sans with spacious gaps, is built for steady reading.
